original:
कर्णः सेनापतिर्भूत्वा कौरवाणामरिंदमः ।
युयुधे पाण्डवैः सार्धं दर्शयन् वीर्यमुत्तमम् ॥
sanskrit:
कर्णः सेनापतिर्भूत्वा कौरवाणामरिंदमः ।
युयुधे पाण्डवैः सार्धं दर्शयन् वीर्यमुत्तमम् ॥
transliteration:
karṇaḥ senāpatir bhūtvā kauravāṇām ariṃdamaḥ |
yuyudhe pāṇḍavaiḥ sārdhaṃ darśayan vīryam uttamam ||
translation: Karna, the vanquisher of foes, assumed leadership of the Kaurava army and engaged the Pandavas, exhibiting consummate archery and valor.

layers.author: gita_press
layers.content: शत्रुदमन कर्ण कौरवों के सेनापति बने और उन्होंने अद्वितीय पराक्रम प्रदर्शित करते हुए पाण्डवों के साथ भीषण संग्राम किया।

layers.author: traditional
layers.content: शत्रूंचे दमन करणारे कर्ण कौरवांचे सेनापती झाले आणि त्यांनी अतुलनीय पराक्रम गाजवत पांडवांशी घनघोर युद्ध केले.

layers.author: km_ganguli
layers.content: Karna Parva culminates in the climactic single combat between Arjuna and Karna on the seventeenth day.

layers.author: nilakantha
layers.content: Nilakantha highlights Karna's tragic nobility and steadfast adherence to his friendship with Duryodhana despite divine warnings.
